note: Per metric, margin = max(3 x the largest |A/A - 1| of every gated reading of one calibration take on a whole held block, 0.03). Each ceiling = the worst reading of the change's own code across takes on at least two different days on that block, x (1 + its metric's margin): the margin covers the spread inside one run, the second day the drift between takes, which that spread does not. `readings` lists the readings behind each ceiling. A ceiling is not raised while the code under it still fits.
